semanticPredicates.ABS_DIFF_LE(TOL): |a - b| <= TOL, per scalar component (never a Euclidean distance; AR3-20), absolute (never relative); -0.0 equals +0.0; a non-finite value is UNKNOWN
semanticPredicates.ANGLE_DIFF_LE(TOL_ANGLE): EQUAL when the wrapped difference of the two angles, computed by the rule of the slot NORM_ANGLE, is <= TOL_ANGLE; the rule of NORM_ANGLE is written only in the kind baseline (V2.2 PA-9), this specification names the slot
semanticPredicates.NORMAL_ANGLE_LE(TOL_NORMAL): both vectors normalized (a zero-length vector is UNKNOWN); EQUAL when the angle between them <= TOL_NORMAL
semanticPredicates.EXACT_STRING: ordinal equality of the stored text
semanticPredicates.CANONICAL_JSON_EQUAL: both sides parsed from the wire text; objects compared as maps with ordinally sorted keys; arrays by position; strings exact; numbers by the exact JSON number token (AR3-19); whitespace not significant; a member present on either side that the authoritative reader does not expose is UNKNOWN_MEMBER_UNSUPPORTED
semanticPredicates.SCHEMA_VERSION_RECOGNIZED: an unrecognized schema version makes the comparison UNKNOWN
semanticPredicates.TYPE_SUPPORTED: an object whose exact host class is outside section 2.3.1 makes the comparison UNKNOWN

semanticSlotInstanceRule: SV-06, SV-07, SV-10 and SV-11 carry no tolerance value. The Q-FPSPEC-VECTORS harness instantiates them from the sealed slot values of the kind baseline: persisted = the binary64 nearest (ties to even) to the exact real value of slotExpression, component by component; it then checks, in exact arithmetic, that the realized difference is <= the slot for an EQUAL vector and > the slot for a DIFFERENT vector; an instance that fails the check is INVALID (reported, never PASS)

semanticVectors.rule: key order and whitespace are not significant; the unknown member (read into ExtensionData) is present and equal
a writer that DROPS an unknown member does not pass (O4 through S-2/S-3)
a writer that ALTERS an unknown member does not pass

a valid design (SelectiveBayDocument.Levels is a list); the unknown member sits in a bay, whose type declares no ExtensionData (JsonExtensionData is not recursive, I-11), so the reader drops it on both sides: never EQUAL; surfaced explicitly, gives UNKNOWN (O5 path)
signed zero is domain-equivalent for any tolerance value; secondary finding BIT_LEVEL_DIFFERENCE_DOMAIN_EQUIVALENT; the exact digests differ (EV-01 / EV-02)
a difference of half the slot is inside it (per component, absolute)
a difference of twice the slot is outside it; the base value 10 separates the absolute reading from a relative one (a relative tolerance of 10 * TOL_LENGTH would give EQUAL)
an unrecognized schema version is UNKNOWN

the persisted object has a class outside section 2.3.1, so no typed form exists: the comparison is UNKNOWN (never EQUAL, never DIFFERENT); the O1 consequence for closure members belongs to section 2.5
the two angles differ by 0.5 * TOL_ANGLE across the wrap at 2pi; EQUAL under any NORM_ANGLE rule that reduces modulo 2pi
the angle between the normalized vectors is 2 * TOL_NORMAL; a zero-length vector is UNKNOWN
PA-8 rule 1 "exact numbers" read as the exact JSON number token (Architect interpretation, AR3-19): 1 and 1.0 differ
texts, names and enum values are compared exactly (stored case)
